title: Byzantine Finance
tagline: Zero-fee restaking protocol made to be easy to use. We make sure our stakers and operators never know just how much we do for them. Also, highly modular to maximise composability and flexibility.
description: In two years at most, every Ethereum staker will be restaking through Eigenlayer - it's great for the ecosystem, great for security, and great for returns. Problem is that right now, that is incredibly technically complicated both for stakers and for operators. So, we decided to make it really easy.
how_its_made:
Front-end built on next.js, react.js, and Dynamic.xyz for the wallet integration. To host our front-end, we use Vercel because it directly deploys from Github.

Back-end is built on EigenLayer's smart contracts for the restaking and the Obol.dev SDK for the distributed validator tech. The back-end code is mostly in solidity with some TypeScript for the integration with Obol.
